# Provenance: superslicer

Copied unmodified on 2026-10-25 from `modules/gcode-parser/test/fixtures/superslicer/` (gcode-parser 0.8.5), so this module's integration test has a file from each slicer without reaching into another module. Generator, version, settings and licence as stated there, reproduced below.

`superslicer-2.3.56-arcwelder.gcode` is a third-party sample, downloaded unmodified on 2026-10-25 from `https://github.com/kageurufu/preprocess_cancellation` (GPL-3.0, compatible with AGPL-3.0-or-later), commit `44140d6964f2a4c90014309a5b26103cc82164c5`, path `GCode/superslicer.gcode`. Header: `; generated by SuperSlicer 2.3.56 on 2021-09-03 at 16:50:39 UTC`, printer_model Voron_v2_300_aferburner, one extruder. The file was post-processed by ArcWelder (`; Postprocessed by ArcWelder`, resolution 0.05 mm), so it contains G2/G3 arcs that SuperSlicer itself did not emit; that is the arc-fitting sample.

supermerill/SuperSlicer (AGPL-3.0) carries only two 1.8 KB header-less snippets (`tests/data/test_gcode/4113_fan_mover*.gcode`), not usable as a corpus file.
